visual_history.assessment:
- Leaflets are too thin, appearing as 1D lines rather than blades in the renders.
- Bending logic is global (all droop in -Z) instead of relative to the rachis curvature, creating an unnatural "comb" look.
- The width orientation of leaflets doesn't follow the rachis curve, causing them to align poorly as the stem sways.
The model faithfully represents a pinnate palm frond with an arching rachis and symmetrically arranged tapering leaflets.
